scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent omitted both opening branding ('S-Net enterprise and residential broadband support, Umar speaking...') and closing branding ('Have a good day. Goodbye.'), completely failing to say 'Thank you for calling S-Net' or 'Thank you for choosing S-Net'.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Agent asked the customer to repeat packet loss and jitter measurements at turn 40, which John had already explicitly stated at turn 5.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Agent made a highly unprofessional, rude remark at turn 17 ('running a commercial telephone brokerage over a cheap residential broadband line... is bound to sound terrible'), insulting the customer's business.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Agent completely failed to probe the softphone setup, omitting checks regarding SIP ALG toggles on the Hub, software codec selection (G.711 vs G.729), or local operating system firewall settings.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Agent abruptly ended the call at turn 54 while the customer was asking about adding a second softphone, hanging up without confirming complete resolution.

grader.scenario: VoIP call echo and severe jitter on home office softphone setup
grader.notes: Home office VoIP call echo and jitter call handled by Umar. Customer's recruitment consultancy experienced robotic distortion and dropped calls. Agent paraphrased well and pushed ACS QoS profile, but failed 5 criteria: Branding (both opening and closing omitted), Active Listening (repeat question), Professionalism (rude remark about cheap line), Probing (omitted SIP ALG/codec checks), and Confirmed Resolved (cut off caller at closing).
